title: Dino AI · An AI that learns on its own
description: An AI that learns, all by itself, to play Chrome’s dinosaur game: it looks at the screen like a person would and gets better with every attempt. Reinforcement learning (PPO) + computer vision.

title: World Cup 2026 · AI prediction
description: Machine-learning model that predicts the 2026 World Cup: blends Elo ratings with XGBoost regressors, models the minute of each goal and simulates the knockouts with Monte Carlo (50k+ historical matches). World-Cup-style web with bracket, groups, favorites and per-match detail.

title: Dexter · Custom AI assistants
description: A collection of AI assistants anyone can install and combine as needed, with 46+ ready-to-use skills, persistent memory and multi-agent support. Open source.

title: Nexo · Your WhatsApp assistant
description: Serves customers on WhatsApp 24/7 using the official WhatsApp Business API: understands text, voice notes and photos, and resolves with no human in the loop. Also works as a centralized multi-agent platform.

title: Lumen · Ask your numbers
description: Ask about your sales or finances in plain language — typing or speaking — and get a clear answer instantly, no spreadsheets required. Charts, tables and natural-language reporting over your ERP data.

title: Brújula · Your numbers on WhatsApp
description: Conversational business intelligence system connecting enterprise ERPs with WhatsApp to query real-time sales, profit margins, inventory, and executive KPIs.

title: Núcleo · Your business in one screen
description: Organizes your schedule, resources and day-to-day operations in one real-time place, synced with your calendar so no appointment slips through.

title: Vértice · A custom-built app
description: A custom application to manage a team’s internal processes (projects, quotes, payments). Keeps working offline and protects access with secure authentication. React + FastAPI + PostgreSQL + Docker.

title: Vitrina · Your online store
description: A complete, ready-to-sell online store: category catalog, cart with promotions, stock alerts and instant product search. Fully responsive.

title: MyAccountant · Your money, in order
description: Personal finance and accounting system with 100% offline-first architecture. Zero external servers and zero cloud: encrypted local storage in IndexedDB, automated monthly balance sheets, and private expense tracking.

title: Landing page · Audiovisual portfolio
description: Netflix-style landing page for an audiovisual marketing creative: billboard hero, video catalog with a built-in player, animated hover and full SEO (Open Graph + structured data). Design, frontend and deployment end to end.

title: Festo · Automatic birthday wishes
description: Every morning it checks whose birthday it is and sends a greeting with a personalized image over chat, automatically. Nobody on the team has to remember.

title: Pulso · Offline-first surveys
description: Run satisfaction surveys anywhere, even with no signal. Responses are saved locally and sync automatically the moment the connection returns. Offline-first PWA.

title: Totem · Control your billboard screen
description: A remote control for digital billboards: change content instantly from your phone, stream Facebook videos and show live weather.

title: Web Studio
description: Explore the original AI-assisted timeline, media library, monitor and inspector with a fictional sample project.

title: Distrito
description: Explore the original 3D room, animated pets and controls with fictional player data.

title: Ruta Clara
description: Explore the original maps, street routes, orders, loading and reports with fictional operations.

title: Ourway
description: Explore the original orbital scene, planets, textures and navigation. The sample trip contains no private photos or locations. Private album connections are disabled.

title: Radar
description: Explore the original navigation and panels with fictional customers, quotes and monthly series. Modules without sample data remain empty. No ERP or company database is connected.

title: Inferencia eficiente
description: Applied research breaking the 4 GB VRAM wall on consumer GPUs: INT4/INT3/INT2 quantization, GPTQ and low-rank residual patches to run 7B models in ~2.4 GB.

title: Obra Maestra MN
description: 2D resource-gathering and construction platformer. Built with Unity, compiled to WebGL/WASM and optimized for seamless mobile and desktop web play.

title: CORA · Conversational AI Assistant
description: Smart assistant with AI-Native UI that serves customers across messaging channels: understands text, voice notes, and images, searches vector catalogs, and provides 24/7 expert sales recommendations.
